acceptance_criteria.description: Users must not be able to access any page without first logging in with valid credentials.
kane_steps: Navigate directly to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html without logging in
Observe that the application redirects the user away from the protected page
Confirm the user is presented with the login page and cannot proceed without credentials
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Protected pages require login before access

acceptance_criteria.description: After entering valid credentials (standard_user / secret_sauce) and submitting the login form, the user is redirected to the product inventory page.
kane_steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/
Enter username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce'
Click the login button
Confirm the user is redirected to the inventory page (e.g. /inventory.html)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Successful login redirects to inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page must display product tiles, each showing the product name, image, and price.
kane_steps: Log in with valid credentials and land on the inventory page
Inspect each product tile and confirm it displays a product name
Confirm each tile shows a product image
Confirm each tile shows a product price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Inventory tiles show name, image, and price

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product name on the inventory page opens that product's detail page.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on a product name link
Confirm the user is navigated to the product detail page for that product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product name opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product image on the inventory page opens that product's detail page.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on a product image
Confirm the user is navigated to the product detail page for that product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product image opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: The product detail page must display the product name, description, price, and an 'Add to cart' button.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on any product to open its detail page
Confirm the detail page shows the product name, description, and price
Confirm an 'Add to cart' button is visible on the page
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Product detail shows name, description, price, button

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can add a product to the cart from the inventory page by clicking the 'Add to cart' button on a product tile.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Locate a product tile and click its 'Add to cart' button
Confirm the product is added to the cart (e.g. cart badge increments)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button adds product from inventory

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking 'Add to cart' on a product tile, the button label for that product changes to 'Remove'.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the 'Add to cart' button on any product tile
Confirm the button label for that product changes to 'Remove'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button changes to Remove

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart badge in the top navigation updates to reflect the current number of items in the cart when a product is added.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Note the current cart badge count (or its absence)
Click 'Add to cart' on one product
Confirm the cart badge in the top navigation shows the updated item count
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart badge updates with item count

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can remove a product from the inventory page by clicking the 'Remove' button on a product tile.
kane_steps: Log in, navigate to the inventory page, and add a product to the cart
Locate the 'Remove' button on the same product tile
Click the 'Remove' button
Confirm the product is removed from the cart (e.g. cart badge decrements)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Remove button removes product from inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking 'Remove' on a product tile, the button label changes back to 'Add to cart'.
kane_steps: Log in, navigate to the inventory page, and add a product to the cart
Click the 'Remove' button on that product tile
Confirm the button label reverts to 'Add to cart'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Remove button reverts to Add to cart

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can navigate to the cart page at /cart.html.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the cart icon or navigate to /cart.html
Confirm the cart page loads successfully

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart page lists all items that have been added, displaying each item's name, quantity, and price.
kane_steps: Log in, add one or more products to the cart from the inventory page
Navigate to the cart page at /cart.html
Confirm all added items are listed
Confirm each listed item displays its name, quantity, and price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart page lists items with name, quantity, price

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can sort products on the inventory page using a sort dropdown located in the top right.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Locate the sort dropdown in the top right of the page
Confirm the dropdown is clickable and presents sorting options
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Sort dropdown is available on inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The sort dropdown must offer exactly four options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), and Price (high to low).
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown
Confirm the four options 'Name (A to Z)', 'Name (Z to A)', 'Price (low to high)', and 'Price (high to low)' are present
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Sort dropdown contains all four sort options

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Price (low to high)' sorts the product list so that the cheapest product (Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99) appears first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Select 'Price (low to high)' from the sort dropdown
Confirm the first product displayed is Sauce Labs Onesie
Confirm its price is $7.99
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Price low to high shows cheapest product first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Name (A to Z)' sorts the product list alphabetically so that Sauce Labs Backpack appears first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Select 'Name (A to Z)' from the sort dropdown
Confirm the first product displayed is Sauce Labs Backpack
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Name A to Z shows Backpack first
